svg.title: Step 4: Opportunity and score (now versus target)
svg.desc: Step 4 Opportunity and score. Now: Regex extraction; Candidate's stack hard-coded; Fit score is degenerate; Two scorers. Target: Requirement extraction task; lead-promote turns a lead into a jobs row; Hard gates before any score; 10-factor score, weights out of 100. Metric: Score varies across kept leads at once (R9.1); after 100 sends the top score decile replies at ≥ 2x the rate of the bottom half.
